name: Easy Color Switch Obby!
desc:
Welcome to Easy Color Switch Obby!

It's basically an obby game but with a twist! The stages are set up to work with color, so try and figure out how to pass each stage using your color selector!

Premium benefits: x2 Speed, x2 Jump, Sparkles Giver

Use code "L0V33" for sweet surprise!

Please like and favourite the game for future updates and to show your support!
